title: 厭氧氨氧化脫氮~Anammox nitrogen removal
focus: 部分亞硝化與厭氧氨氧化的氮收支~Nitrogen balances across partial nitritation and anammox
summary: 本課以部分亞硝化與厭氧氨氧化的氮收支為主線，從側流氨氮負荷、電子受體配比、前段部分亞硝化、反應器容積負荷進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。~This course develops nitrogen balances across partial nitritation and anammox through ten connected units, beginning with sidestream ammonium load, electron-acceptor ratio, upstream partial nitritation, reactor volumetric loading. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

units.title: 側流氨氮負荷~Sidestream ammonium load
units.mechanism: 消化回流水的高氨濃度須轉成質量負荷，才能與主流比較。~Convert high sidestream ammonium concentration to mass load before comparing it with the mainstream.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Q=1200 m³/d；NH4-N=40 mg/L。模型 LN=QCN/1000，代入得到 48 kg N/d。適用邊界：所有氮濃度以 N 質量計；不可混用 NH4 的分子質量。~Original teaching assumptions: Q=1200 m³/d; NH4-N=40 mg/L. Model LN=QCN/1000 gives 48 kg N/d. Applicability: All concentrations are on an N-mass basis, not NH4 molecular mass.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「側流氨氮負荷」的觀測點。校正流量與氨氮儀，保留採樣時段。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for sidestream ammonium load. Calibrate flow and ammonium instruments and retain the sampling interval. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 小水量不代表氮負荷小。診斷與介入：把各流股氮物種分列，查核高氨回流是否漏算。~Small flow does not imply small nitrogen loading. Diagnostic response: Separate nitrogen species for every stream and check for omitted ammonium-rich returns.
units.misconception: 只依水量比例可估算側流氮比例。~Flow fraction alone gives the nitrogen fraction.
units.practice: 只改變 Q:1200→1500 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 48 變為 60 kg N/d。用「側流氨氮負荷」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Q:1200→1500 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 48 to 60 kg N/d. Explain the direction using sidestream ammonium load, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 電子受體配比~Electron-acceptor ratio
units.mechanism: 厭氧氨氧化把氨與亞硝酸耦合轉化，兩者不足或過量都須由物種收支辨識。~Anammox couples ammonium and nitrite; diagnose shortage or excess through species balances.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設 NH4-N=50 kg/d；NO2-N/NH4-N 化學計量比=1.32。模型 NO2-N=1.32×NH4-N，代入得到 66 kg N/d。適用邊界：選定的厭氧氨氧化化學計量近似，不是通用投料設定。~Original teaching assumptions: Assume NH4-N=50 kg/d; nitrite/ammonium N ratio=1.32. Model NO2-N=1.32×NH4-N gives 66 kg N/d. Applicability: A selected anammox stoichiometric approximation, not a universal feeding setpoint.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「電子受體配比」的觀測點。把氨、亞硝酸與硝酸的氮基準量測放在同一表。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for electron-acceptor ratio. Tabulate ammonium, nitrite and nitrate measurements on the same N basis. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只量總氮無法分辨亞硝酸累積。診斷與介入：用同時段氨與亞硝酸分析校對比例，避免單看一支探頭。~Total nitrogen alone misses nitrite accumulation. Diagnostic response: Check ratios using time-matched ammonium/nitrite analysis rather than one probe.
units.misconception: 只供氨即可持續厭氧氨氧化。~Ammonium alone sustains anammox.
units.practice: 只改變 NH4-N:50→60 kg/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 66 變為 79.2 kg N/d。用「電子受體配比」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only NH4-N:50→60 kg/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 66 to 79.2 kg N/d. Explain the direction using electron-acceptor ratio, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 前段部分亞硝化~Upstream partial nitritation
units.mechanism: 僅將部分氨轉為亞硝酸，保留另一部分作厭氧氨氧化底物。~Oxidize only part of the ammonium to nitrite, retaining the rest for anammox.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設亞硝酸與剩餘氨氮需求比 r=1.32。模型 f=r/(1+r)，代入得到 0.56896552 fraction。適用邊界：忽略同化與其他反應的前段部分亞硝化比例；需用實測氮收支校正。~Original teaching assumptions: Assume required nitrite-to-remaining-ammonium N ratio r=1.32. Model f=r/(1+r) gives 0.56896552 fraction. Applicability: Upstream partial-nitritation fraction ignoring assimilation and side reactions; calibrate against a measured nitrogen balance.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「前段部分亞硝化」的觀測點。以進出段氮物種確認剩餘氨與所生成亞硝酸。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for upstream partial nitritation. Check remaining ammonium and produced nitrite from inlet/outlet nitrogen species. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 完全硝化會消耗下游所需的氨與亞硝酸。診斷與介入：重新閉合氮物種收支，將同化與副反應列成獨立項。~Complete nitrification consumes needed downstream substrates. Diagnostic response: Reclose species balances with assimilation and side reactions separated.
units.misconception: 前段氨全部硝化一定最好。~Complete upstream nitrification is always best.
units.practice: 只改變 r:1.32→1.20，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.56896552 變為 0.54545455 fraction。用「前段部分亞硝化」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only r:1.32→1.20, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.56896552 to 0.54545455 fraction. Explain the direction using upstream partial nitritation, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 反應器容積負荷~Reactor volumetric loading
units.mechanism: 用每日氮量除有效容積建立負荷，但顆粒活性決定實際反應餘裕。~Normalize daily nitrogen by effective volume, while granule activity determines actual reserve.
units.model: 原創教學假設：N 負荷=100 kg N/d；反應容積=200 m³。模型 NLR=LN/V，代入得到 0.5 kg N/(m³·d)。適用邊界：容積負荷不能代替顆粒活性與可接受毒性資料。~Original teaching assumptions: N load=100 kg N/d; reactor volume=200 m³. Model NLR=LN/V gives 0.5 kg N/(m³·d). Applicability: Volumetric loading does not replace granule activity or inhibition data.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「反應器容積負荷」的觀測點。把體積、氮負荷、比活性與顆粒流失分列。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for reactor volumetric loading. Record volume, N loading, specific activity and granule loss separately. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 同容積不同菌量不能假設有相同容量。診斷與介入：查有效容積、活性與顆粒流失，再測負荷敏感度。~Equal volumes with different biomass do not have equal capacity. Diagnostic response: Check effective volume, activity and granule loss before a loading sensitivity test.
units.misconception: 容積負荷相同就保證相同出水。~Equal volumetric loading guarantees equal effluent.
units.practice: 只改變 LN:100→130 kg N/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.5 變為 0.65 kg N/(m³·d)。用「反應器容積負荷」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only LN:100→130 kg N/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.5 to 0.65 kg N/(m³·d). Explain the direction using reactor volumetric loading, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 顆粒保留~Granule retention
units.mechanism: 沉降、篩分或載體保留慢生長菌，水力停留與菌體停留須分開。~Settling, screening or carriers retain slow-growing organisms; distinguish hydraulic and biomass residence.
units.model: 原創教學假設：固體庫存 MX=4500 kg；排泥=180 kg/d；出流水固體=20 kg/d。模型 SRT=MX/(W+E)，代入得到 22.5 d。適用邊界：全系統固體收支的準穩態估計；回流不是離開系統的排泥。~Original teaching assumptions: Solids inventory MX=4500 kg; wasting=180 kg/d; effluent solids=20 kg/d. Model SRT=MX/(W+E) gives 22.5 d. Applicability: Quasi-steady whole-system solids balance; return sludge is not a solids exit.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「顆粒保留」的觀測點。從排泥流量、含固率與出流水 TSS 各算質量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for granule retention. Calculate masses independently from wasting flow, solids fraction and effluent TSS. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 失去顆粒後補水量不會恢復菌量。診斷與介入：用實際排出乾固體修正 SRT，分開回流與離開系統的流股。~Replacing water after granule loss does not restore biomass. Diagnostic response: Correct SRT with actual exported dry solids, separating recycle from system exits.
units.misconception: 水力停留時間就是污泥齡。~HRT is the sludge age.
units.practice: 只改變 W:180→230 kg/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 22.5 變為 18 d。用「顆粒保留」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only W:180→230 kg/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 22.5 to 18 d. Explain the direction using granule retention, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 亞硝化氧需求~Nitritation oxygen demand
units.mechanism: 部分亞硝化需氧而厭氧氨氧化受氧影響，供氧須在流程邊界中理解。~Partial nitritation requires oxygen while anammox responds to oxygen; interpret aeration by process boundary.
units.model: 原創教學假設：NH4-N 亞硝化=40 kg/d；理論 O2/N=3.43。模型 O2=3.43×N，代入得到 137.2 kg O2/d。適用邊界：僅氨氧化至亞硝酸，不含生長、異營耗氧與傳氧效率。~Original teaching assumptions: NH4-N nitritation=40 kg/d; theoretical O2/N=3.43. Model O2=3.43×N gives 137.2 kg O2/d. Applicability: Ammonium-to-nitrite demand only, excluding growth, heterotrophic demand and transfer efficiency.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「亞硝化氧需求」的觀測點。以 NH4-N 與 NO2-N 質量變化對照耗氧。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for nitritation oxygen demand. Compare ammonium/nitrite mass change with oxygen use. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只因程序名稱含厭氧就完全忽略前段需氧。診斷與介入：先分清亞硝化和完全硝化需氧，核對生成的氮物種。~The word anaerobic does not eliminate upstream oxygen demand. Diagnostic response: Separate nitritation from complete-nitrification demand and check products.
units.misconception: 整套系統所有單元都不需要氧。~No unit in the full system needs oxygen.
units.practice: 只改變 N:40→45 kg/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 137.2 變為 154.35 kg O2/d。用「亞硝化氧需求」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only N:40→45 kg/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 137.2 to 154.35 kg O2/d. Explain the direction using nitritation oxygen demand, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 游離氨分率~Free-ammonia fraction
units.mechanism: 同一 TAN 在不同 pH、溫度具有不同 NH3 分率，濃度基準不可混用。~Identical TAN has different NH3 fractions at different pH and temperature; keep reporting bases consistent.
units.model: 原創教學假設：TAN=50 mg N/L；pH=7.5；假設 pKa=9.25。模型 FA=TAN/(1+10^(pKa-pH))，代入得到 0.87360457 mg NH3-N/L。適用邊界：pKa 隨溫度、離子強度改變；此例不是生物抑制閾值。~Original teaching assumptions: TAN=50 mg N/L; pH=7.5; assumed pKa=9.25. Model FA=TAN/(1+10^(pKa-pH)) gives 0.87360457 mg NH3-N/L. Applicability: pKa varies with temperature and ionic strength; this is not a biological inhibition threshold.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「游離氨分率」的觀測點。以校正 pH、溫度與總氨氮重算，而非直接以 TAN 判斷游離氨。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for free-ammonia fraction. Recalculate from calibrated pH, temperature and TAN instead of equating TAN with free ammonia. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 用 TAN 直接對照游離氨值會誤判抑制。診斷與介入：校正 pH 與溫度後重算，將抑制判斷留給相符的活性試驗。~Comparing TAN directly with free ammonia misreads inhibition. Diagnostic response: Recalculate after pH/temperature calibration and assess inhibition with matched activity tests.
units.misconception: 游離氨分率與 pH 無關。~Free-ammonia fraction is independent of pH.
units.practice: 只改變 pH:7.5→8.0，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.87360457 變為 2.6620108 mg NH3-N/L。用「游離氨分率」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only pH:7.5→8.0, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.87360457 to 2.6620108 mg NH3-N/L. Explain the direction using free-ammonia fraction, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 限制基質與比活性~Limiting substrate and activity
units.mechanism: 飽和動力式只描述限制基質作用，不能代表高濃度毒性與菌群競爭。~Saturation kinetics describe limitation, not high-concentration toxicity or community competition.
units.model: 原創教學假設：S=10 mg/L；Ks=5 mg/L；μmax=0.1 d⁻¹。模型 μ=μmax S/(Ks+S)，代入得到 0.066666667 d⁻¹。適用邊界：假設單一限制基質且無抑制；不能用此式證明高濃度永遠有利。~Original teaching assumptions: S=10 mg/L; Ks=5 mg/L; μmax=0.1 d⁻¹. Model μ=μmax S/(Ks+S) gives 0.066666667 d⁻¹. Applicability: Assumes one limiting substrate and no inhibition; it cannot show that high concentration is always beneficial.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「限制基質與比活性」的觀測點。以批次比活性測試檢查是否真的符合飽和曲線。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for limiting substrate and activity. Check the saturation curve with batch specific-activity tests. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 用單一 Monod 曲線外推所有毒性情境。診斷與介入：增加低高濃度測點檢查模型，不把飽和模型外插到抑制區。~Extrapolating one Monod curve to every toxic condition fails. Diagnostic response: Add low/high substrate observations without extrapolating saturation models into inhibition.
units.misconception: 基質濃度加倍速率必定加倍。~Doubling substrate always doubles the rate.
units.practice: 只改變 S:10→20 mg/L，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.066666667 變為 0.08 d⁻¹。用「限制基質與比活性」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only S:10→20 mg/L, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.066666667 to 0.08 d⁻¹. Explain the direction using limiting substrate and activity, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 停留分布與短流~Residence distribution and bypass
units.mechanism: 示蹤曲線可辨識反應器短流，避免把平均時間當所有水粒子的接觸時間。~Tracer curves reveal bypass rather than assigning the mean contact time to every parcel.
units.model: 原創教學假設：V=1500 m³；Q=3000 m³/d。模型 θ=24V/Q，代入得到 12 h。適用邊界：名義水力停留時間；不包含短流、死角及回流的停留時間分布。~Original teaching assumptions: V=1500 m³; Q=3000 m³/d. Model θ=24V/Q gives 12 h. Applicability: Nominal hydraulic residence time; it does not resolve short-circuiting, dead zones or recirculation residence-time distributions.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「停留分布與短流」的觀測點。以槽有效容積與示蹤劑穿透曲線交叉檢查。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for residence distribution and bypass. Cross-check effective volume with a tracer breakthrough curve. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 名義停留足夠但早期突破仍可造成氮流失。診斷與介入：用示蹤曲線及有效容積修正假設，先在模擬中比較分流方案。~Early breakthrough can lose nitrogen even with adequate nominal residence. Diagnostic response: Revise assumptions using tracing/effective volume and compare flow-distribution options in simulation first.
units.misconception: 平均停留時間即可排除短流。~Mean residence excludes short-circuiting.
units.practice: 只改變 Q:3000→3600 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 12 變為 10 h。用「停留分布與短流」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Q:3000→3600 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 12 to 10 h. Explain the direction using residence distribution and bypass, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 氮收支與副產物~Nitrogen balance and by-products
units.mechanism: 分列氨、亞硝酸、硝酸與菌體，剩餘差額須附量測不確定度。~Separate ammonium, nitrite, nitrate and biomass and attach uncertainty to the residual.
units.model: 原創教學假設：進流 NH4-N=100、NO2-N=132；出流 NO3-N=26 kg N/d。模型 Nother=Nin-Nout，代入得到 206 kg N/d。適用邊界：未測項包括 N2、菌體與誤差；不能只憑差值宣稱都是氮氣。~Original teaching assumptions: Influent NH4-N=100, NO2-N=132; effluent NO3-N=26 kg N/d. Model Nother=Nin-Nout gives 206 kg N/d. Applicability: Unmeasured terms include N2, biomass and error; the residual is not proof that all nitrogen became gas.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「氮收支與副產物」的觀測點。另外量菌體固體與各溶解氮，列出收支殘差。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for nitrogen balance and by-products. Measure biomass and dissolved nitrogen separately and report the balance residual. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 把未測氮全部當 N2 會忽略其他氣態與固態途徑。診斷與介入：另外測固體及其他氮途徑，保留未閉合殘差。~Calling all unmeasured nitrogen N2 ignores other gaseous and solid routes. Diagnostic response: Measure solids and other N pathways and retain the unclosed residual.
units.misconception: 氮收支差額全部等於已證實的 N2。~Every nitrogen-balance residual is proven N2.
units.practice: 只改變 NO3-N:26→32 kg N/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 206 變為 200 kg N/d。用「氮收支與副產物」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only NO3-N:26→32 kg N/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 206 to 200 kg N/d. Explain the direction using nitrogen balance and by-products, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

facts: 生物、物理與化學處理都必須以同一邊界的質量及能量收支檢核。~Biological, physical and chemical treatment must be checked through mass and energy balances with consistent boundaries.
